desc: Derive the component-type game: classify components as A/B/C/I, list merge transitions with T-parity changes, and establish that only T mod 2 matters for win/lose.
Implement the reduced even-N DP, period search, graph classification, and final answer logic in the current solver.

Validate the current solver against an exact exhaustive game search on small bipartite graphs (N <= 6, random N <= 7), including states with even positive missing edges; report any mismatch and minimal counterexample.

Prove or independently verify the per-type eventual periods used for large counts, or derive a closed-form outcome for the reduced component game; if a counterexample is found, revise the reduction/table.
Run final validation and stress tests: samples, edge cases, brute-force small graphs, cross-check reduction against exact DP up to K=60, and performance test N=2e5; fix any mismatch.
